body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>

dreamGEAR has presented its intriguing speaker at CES 2006. When you touch the surface of the transparent dome, it displays mysterious beams from inside. The beams are also on and off according to different beats of music.
